tests.name: patch_deep_shared_prefix_many_steps
tests.intent: Verify patch performance and correctness when applying multiple operations with long shared prefixes exceeding the 16-step threshold.

tests.name: patch_short_prefix_below_threshold
tests.intent: Verify that patching operations with fewer than 16 cached steps execute successfully using the standard path cache resolution branch.

tests.name: patch_boundary_token_difference
tests.intent: Verify that path prefix matching handles cases where paths diverge exactly at token boundaries correctly.

tests.name: patch_removal_vanishing_cached_path
tests.intent: Verify patch operations when an intermediate object containing a cached path is removed.

tests.name: ordered_json_patch_deep_prefix
tests.intent: Verify ordered_json patch application with deeply nested paths sharing long prefixes.

tests.name: patch_exact_sixteen_steps
tests.intent: Test path prefix resolution at exactly the 16-step threshold boundary where transition from linear to calculated common prefix occurs.

tests.name: patch_seventeen_steps
tests.intent: Test path prefix resolution at 17 steps, activating the deepest_shared_step optimization path.

tests.name: patch_insert_above_cached_path
tests.intent: Verify that inserting an element above a cached path correctly invalidates or adjusts the matching steps.

tests.name: patch_path_is_prefix_of_another
tests.intent: Verify patching where one path is a complete prefix of the subsequently requested path.

tests.name: json_pointer_comparison_and_streaming
tests.intent: Exercise json_pointer comparison operators and ostream insertion to verify interaction with public json_pointer interfaces.

tests.name: json_pointer_concatenation_operators
tests.intent: Exercise json_pointer division/concatenation operators with strings and indices.

tests.name: patch_empty_and_root_pointers
tests.intent: Verify patching operations targeting empty or root-level JSON pointers alongside deeply nested ones.

tests.name: patch_array_indices_deep
tests.intent: Verify patch operations involving array indices within deeply nested structures.

tests.name: patch_error_handling_invalid_pointer
tests.intent: Verify exception propagation when a patch operation references an invalid or non-existent JSON pointer.

tests.name: patch_multiple_branches_interleaved
tests.intent: Verify patch performance and correctness with alternating and interleaved deep paths.

tests.name: patch_string_escape_tokens
tests.intent: Verify correct handling of JSON pointers containing escaped characters (~0 and ~1) during patch resolution.

tests.name: patch_non_inplace_returns_new_json
tests.intent: Verify that standard patch() returns a new patched document without altering the original document.

tests.name: json_pointer_string_comparisons
tests.intent: Verify comparisons between json_pointer objects and string literals (lhs and rhs).

tests.name: patch_add_operation_creating_objects
tests.intent: Verify add patch operations that dynamically create intermediate nested objects and properties.

tests.name: patch_multiple_identical_sequential_paths
tests.intent: Verify consecutive patch operations targeting the exact same deep path repeatedly.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Verify deepest_shared_step and path cache resolution with a deeply nested path of 18 steps sharing a prefix that diverges at the end, exercising the > 16 threshold.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercise deepest_shared_step where paths share a large number of common segments (20 steps) but diverge cleanly at a token boundary.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Verify deepest_shared_step when consecutive patch operations share an extremely long prefix across 22 nested array indices and map keys.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Trigger deepest_shared_step with multiple 20-step deep paths where the common prefix spans precisely up to the 19th nested level before diverging.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Test resolve_plain with > 16 cached steps where the path search hits an early termination inside deepest_shared_step due to prefix length boundaries.
